WhatsApp Groups - Pakistan Jobs WhatsApp Group Links 2026 – Govt & Private Job Alerts Links last checked: 20 October 2026 — every group below was opened and verified by our team on this date. Dead links are removed, never kept.Finding a job in Pakistan still runs on connections — and these days, a big part of that connection is WhatsApp. Recruiters in Karachi post vacancies in groups before they ever reach a newspaper. A factory in Faisalabad fills its seats through a group message. Government departments announce tests, and within an hour the alert is circulating in jobs groups across Punjab, Sindh, KP and Balochistan.The problem is finding the groups that are actually alive and actually about jobs. Most lists on the internet are graveyards of reset links and groups that turned into advertising boards months ago. This page is different: every single group below was checked by hand on the date written at the top. If a link dies, we remove it at the next check instead of leaving you to waste your time.Below you will find general Pakistan job alert groups, government job groups, and province-wise groups, so you can join the ones that match your city and your field — and skip the noise.Active Pakistan Jobs WhatsApp GroupsSindh 1 – Jobs Dunya

Education WhatsApp Groups - Study WhatsApp Group Links Pakistan 2026 – CSS, MDCAT, Matric & Exam Prep Links last checked: 20 October 2026 — every group below was opened and verified by our team on this date. Dead links are removed, never kept.Some of the hardest-working rooms in Pakistan are WhatsApp study groups. At 2 a.m. before a CSS paper, someone is sharing solved past papers. A student in a small town near Bahawalpur, whose academy options are limited, prepares for MDCAT shoulder to shoulder with students from Karachi and Lahore — same notes, same tests, same dream. Teachers share guess papers, seniors share what actually worked, and nobody has to prepare alone.The catch is quality. Half the “study” groups on the internet are either dead, full of forwards, or quietly turned into advertising boards for academies. Every group below was opened and checked by hand on the date at the top of this page, so what you join is a room where studying is still the main activity.Pick the group that matches your exam — CSS and PMS aspirants, MDCAT and ECAT students, matric and intermediate classes, and general English and learning groups are all below.Active Study & Exam Preparation Groups in PakistanAIOU STUDENTS 2023 II🗞️
